name: Workflow C - User Notification via AWS SES

parameters.query:
SELECT
    m.match_id,
    u.user_id,
    u.name AS user_name,
    u.email AS original_email,
    u.monthly_income,
    u.credit_score,
    p.product_name,
    p.provider_name,
    p.interest_rate,
    p.source_url,
    m.match_score,
    m.ai_reasoning
FROM matches m
INNER JOIN users u ON u.user_id = m.user_id
INNER JOIN loan_products p ON p.product_id = m.product_id
WHERE m.notified = FALSE
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
LIMIT 5;

UPDATE matches
SET notified = TRUE,
    notified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE match_id = {{ $('Rewrite @example.com to Verified Gmail +Alias').item.json.match_id }};
